description: Permanently delete a landing page. Pass confirm: true to proceed — this is irreversible. Needs email confirmation: this call does NOT delete yet. It emails the account owner a confirm link and returns status pending_email_confirmation (with a pendingActionId). The delete runs only after the link is clicked. Do not retry; use get_pending_action to check the outcome.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion

name: delete_landing_page
